reason: The posted daily cleaning log and the cap on how many kids are in at once are the first things that make me think I could relax here while she chews on everything. I'd use the free visit, and if it really is clean I'd come back a couple of times and bring the moms group.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth. A cleaning log is only paper until I've seen the toys being wiped down myself.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the toys actually cleaned and the room limit held on my free visit. If it's dirty or crowded, I'm done after one visit.
